summary: Frontend-only verification of Michel's 'save image' bug fix + Entreprise Pro teaser modal on iOS-like web viewport (390x844). All 5 tests PASS. Countdown & LinkedIn admin screens now show a visible 'ENREGISTRER L'IMAGE' button that triggers a real cross-platform image download on web (blob → <a download>). Pro-card tap opens a slide-up modal with correct copy (Entreprise MAX, BIENTÔT DISPONIBLE, 199,99 €, 8 feature rows) and both action buttons work as specified. Regression: dashboard admin buttons visibility and copy-caption buttons still behave correctly (Instagram removed, LinkedIn/Facebook present).

issues: When the campaign is complete (15/15 posts published) the default view shows the trophy 'done' box and the ENREGISTRER L'IMAGE button is not rendered — the user has to enter consultation mode by tapping a day row (J1..J15) to access the save button. This matches the code's logic (`shown && !today.done`) but may confuse users who want to re-download a past visual — consider always exposing the save button in consultation mode with a helper hint. Non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Widespread across screens (visible on the very first onboarding/login load). Reference: run RN Web deprecation audit across styles; migrate `shadowColor`, `shadowOffset`, `shadowOpacity`, `shadowRadius` to `boxShadow` for web parity.

action_items: None blocking for the reported bug — the fix is verified: web downloads trigger cleanly (JetonCafe_J-30.png and LinkedIn_Jour01.png). Michel's original iPhone flow (expo-sharing share sheet) cannot be tested from the web preview; recommend Michel verifies on his real device or via a TestFlight build.
Consider: on the LinkedIn screen, always show the save-image button (also when campaign is done) so past visuals can be re-downloaded from the consultation state.
Migrate deprecated `shadow*` RN Web style props to `boxShadow` to silence console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: saveImage.ts (web branch) does not attach auth headers — this works today because /api/linkedin/image/{day} and /api/campaign/countdown/visual/{n} are served without requiring the bearer token cookie/header. If those endpoints are ever locked behind auth headers, the blob fetch will fail with 401 and the fallback window.open will silently 401 too. Consider using the existing `api` axios instance for the fetch, or documenting the endpoints must remain publicly accessible (they use JWT via query-string / referrer? worth double-checking).

index.tsx (Pro teaser) — 'Entreprise MAX' price string '199,99 €/MOIS' in the CHOISIR ENTREPRISE button label is misleading: tapping the button selects the *Entreprise* plan (49,99 €), not MAX. The final button text 'CHOISIR ENTREPRISE — 49,99 €/MOIS' actually already reads 49,99€, so this is fine. No fix needed — flagging for reviewer clarity.

linkedin.tsx — the 'done' state hides the save button entirely. Users in consultation mode after campaign end still get the save button (verified), but the copy is not obvious. Add a small hint 'Consultez un jour ci-dessous pour ré-enregistrer son visuel'.

rca_of_issue: Bug: on Michel's iPhone, long-press on <Image> in Countdown & LinkedIn screens did nothing — RN <Image> does not expose the browser's native context menu because it's rendered as a divs+background-image tree on web and as a native UIImageView on iOS. Fix implemented: a new saveImage util + a visible 'ENREGISTRER L'IMAGE' TouchableOpacity button. On web: fetch→blob→<a download>. On iOS/Android: FileSystem.downloadAsync + Sharing.shareAsync opens the native share sheet where the user picks 'Save to Photos'. Verified web download flow triggers real files (JetonCafe_J-30.png, LinkedIn_Jour01.png). Mobile share-sheet path cannot be exercised from Playwright/web preview — Michel should confirm on his real device.
